## {{< iconify octicon:briefcase-24 aria-hidden="true" >}} What I Do {#what-i-do}

[I]{.drop-cap} build tools that make reproducible research easier for data scientists and researchers.
With a Ph.D. in biostatistics and deep expertise in the Quarto and R ecosystems, I combine statistical rigour with practical usability.
My work spans multi-omics data analysis (genetics, proteomics, metabolomics, transcriptomics) mostly in a research setting, R package development, and Quarto ecosystem contributions.
